reporting-org.narrative: FMO NV (Nederlandse Financierings-Maatschappij voor Ontwikkelingslanden N.V.)

description.narrative: The GABV member banks -many of them also FMO clients in emerging markets- and their clients as ultimate beneficiaries, need to be able to access correspondent banking efficiently and at affordable terms. While the GABV cannot deliver this impact directly, it can help create the framework conditions so that access of its member banks to the international payments system will improve over time.
